proxy-groups:
  # 默认最高优先级策略：手动在测速和各个节点间自由选择切换
  - name: AutoProxy
    type: select
    proxies:
      - ⚡ 自动最快
      - 🔮 智能负载
      - DIRECT
      - "🚀  | SSR_1"
      - "🚀  | SSR_2"
      - "🚀  | SSR_3"
      - "🚀  | SSR_4"
      - "🚀  | SSR_5"
      - "🚀  | SSR_6"
      - "🚀  | SSR_7"
      - "🚀  | SSR_8"

  # 测速选择：每隔 5 分钟向真实测试目标发送 HEAD 连接，自动切入延迟最低极速节点
  - name: ⚡ 自动最快
    type: url-test
    url: http://cp.cloudflare.com/generate_204
    interval: 300
    tolerance: 50
    proxies:
      - "🚀  | SSR_1"
      - "🚀  | SSR_2"
      - "🚀  | SSR_3"
      - "🚀  | SSR_4"
      - "🚀  | SSR_5"
      - "🚀  | SSR_6"
      - "🚀  | SSR_7"
      - "🚀  | SSR_8"

  # 重负载分配器
  - name: 🔮 智能负载
    type: load-balance
    url: http://cp.cloudflare.com/generate_204
    interval: 600
    strategy: consistent-hashing
    proxies:
      - "🚀  | SSR_1"
      - "🚀  | SSR_2"
      - "🚀  | SSR_3"
      - "🚀  | SSR_4"
      - "🚀  | SSR_5"
      - "🚀  | SSR_6"
      - "🚀  | SSR_7"
      - "🚀  | SSR_8"

rules:
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,google.com,AutoProxy
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,github.com,AutoProxy
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,githubusercontent.com,AutoProxy
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,telegram.org,AutoProxy
  - DOMAIN-keyword,youtube,AutoProxy
  - DOMAIN-keyword,twitter,AutoProxy
  - DOMAIN-keyword,netflix,AutoProxy
  - GEOIP,CN,DIRECT
  - MATCH,AutoProxy
